turns.text: I am live in Lahore. Is big city. I like, um, the food there very much and the people.
My work is in shop. I sell the mobile. Every day I go nine o'clock and come back night.
Weekend I am... I am go with family to park. Children play and we eat, um, ice cream.
I want learn English because, uh, for job. Good job need English. My English is not good.
In future I want go abroad, maybe Dubai, for work. My cousin is there, he is say is good.
